metadata.case_name: KHAN SABZ ALI v. KO KIM DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

injuries.description: contusion or sprain injury to the back
source: Having conducted physical and radiological examinations, reviewed the medical records and considered the plaintiff’s complaints, Dr Lee diagnosed the plaintiff of suffering from a contusion injury of the right thigh, right calf and contusion or sprain injury to the back which was consistent with the mechanism of injury; and that the plaintiff probably suffered from a contusion injury to the soft tissue of right thigh and low back.

numbness on knees and left leg
